chunks: Due to the saying of the Prophet, peace be upon him and his family:
"When the sandals become wet, then the salat (prayer) is in the dwellings."

key_terms.الرِّحَالِ: dwellings, lodgings, or places of residence
key_terms.النَّبِيِّ: the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله, whose statement is being cited

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله say about praying in dwellings when conditions are wet?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a prophetic instruction permitting prayer in one's dwellings when conditions outside are wet and difficult. It reflects ease in worship and practical accommodation in congregational prayer circumstances.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "If the sandals are wet, then pray in your dwellings."
